prompt:
Hey, our DevRel team needs a quick-start reference document for new players joining the community. We need a single file called `player_guide.md` placed somewhere in the workspace.

Specifically, the guide should cover:
- What game(s) are currently available and a short description of each
- Which platforms are actually supported for download (be accurate — we've had complaints about people assuming Windows works)
- The exact file(s) a player needs to download, with the precise filename(s)
- Where to go to get the download (point to the right release page)
- Step-by-step commands to unpack and run the game on Linux
- A note about what players can and cannot see inside the distributed binaries (use accurate language here — previous drafts got this wrong)

Please do NOT tell people to check out the source code unless they explicitly ask — we want players using the released builds, not fumbling with a repo.
